replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body: I don't see how you went "ham" on your mouse if the only thing you targeted was the enemy players. Your head never spun like a normal player's head would. The health of the players doesn't matter as the video clearly shows your head aiming to only those players. If you would've gone "Ham" you would've at least seen SOME regular head movement but as you can see, you didn't have any. Your hits were all on target and none of them missed. The video you supplied isn't sufficient evidence that you weren't hacking because it's not while you were on Avicus.
